text.tspan:
Energy use per person vs. GDP per capita
1990 to 2024

Energy refers to
primary energy
, measured in
kilowatt-hours
per person, using the
substitution method
. Gross
domestic product (GDP) is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
Data source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (2026) and other sources

Note: GDP data is expressed in
international-$
at 2021 prices. Where a country or region lacks data for the years shown, the closest available
value within 5 years is shown instead.
